---
title: "CoSparTA Fit Explorer"
format: dashboard
server: shiny
---

```{r}
#| context: setup

library(shiny)
library(ggplot2)
library(CoSparTA)

.dash_input   <- readRDS("dash_data.rds")
fit           <- .dash_input$fit
channel_names <- .dash_input$channel_names
time_labels   <- .dash_input$time_labels

K <- ncol(fit$res$ql$El_normed)

# Replicates scales::hue_pal()'s default algorithm (without adding a
# dependency on scales) so panel 3's per-rank colors match the discrete
# palette ggplot2 uses by default in panels 1-2 when all K components are
# shown, then stays keyed by rank index on non-contiguous subsets.
.hue_pal <- function(n, h = c(0, 360) + 15, c = 100, l = 65,
                      h.start = 0, direction = 1) {
  if ((diff(h) %% 360) < 1) h[2] <- h[2] - 360 / n
  rotate <- function(x) (x + h.start) %% 360 * direction
  grDevices::hcl(h = rotate(seq(h[1], h[2], length.out = n)), c = c, l = l)
}
palette_full <- stats::setNames(.hue_pal(K), as.character(seq_len(K)))

gl_normed <- fit$res$gl_normed
.gamma_len <- function(g) {
  if (!is.null(g) && !is.null(g$type) && identical(g$type, "covariate_dependent")) {
    length(g$gamma)
  } else {
    0L
  }
}
q_max <- max(vapply(gl_normed, .gamma_len, integer(1)), 0L)
any_supervised_fit <- q_max > 0
```

## {.sidebar}

```{r}
checkboxGroupInput(
  "ranks",
  "Components",
  choices  = stats::setNames(as.character(seq_len(K)), paste0("Rank ", seq_len(K))),
  selected = as.character(seq_len(K))
)
```

## Main

<!--
A level-2 heading is required here (rather than starting the rows directly
at level 2) because a page-level sidebar itself occupies a level-2 slot as a
column; without this wrapper, the Row/Column headings below would be
mis-parsed as page-level columns instead of rows. See
https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/8021.

Row/Column heading text must also be unique across the document — reusing
identical text (e.g. "Row" for every row) makes Quarto's dashboard layout
silently collapse later duplicates from side-by-side columns into stacked
full-width rows, with no error. Each Row/Column heading below is therefore
given distinct text even though that text itself is otherwise discarded.
-->

### Patterns Row {height="50%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Temporal pattern"
plotOutput("time_plot")
```

#### Gamma Column {width="60%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Gamma coefficients"
if (any_supervised_fit) {
  tableOutput("gamma_table")
} else {
  tags$p("This fit is fully unsupervised — no covariate-dependent components to display.")
}
```

```{r}
#| context: server

ranks_sel <- reactive({
  req(input$ranks)
  sort(as.integer(input$ranks))
})

output$time_plot <- renderPlot({
  plot_time_factors(fit, ranks = ranks_sel(), time_labels = time_labels)
})

output$channel_plot <- renderPlot({
  plot_channel_factors(fit, ranks = ranks_sel(), channel_names = channel_names,
                        show_names = !is.null(channel_names))
})

output$weight_plot <- renderPlot({
  rs <- ranks_sel()
  df <- data.frame(
    rank     = rs,
    rank_lab = factor(paste0("R", rs), levels = paste0("R", rs)),
    value    = fit$res$lambda_normed[rs]
  )
  ggplot(df, aes(x = rank_lab, y = value, group = 1)) +
    geom_line(color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_point(aes(color = factor(rank, levels = seq_len(K))), size = 3) +
    scale_color_manual(values = palette_full, name = "Rank") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Component weight") +
    theme_minimal()
})

if (any_supervised_fit) {
  output$gamma_table <- renderTable({
    rs        <- ranks_sel()
    col_names <- paste0("V", seq_len(q_max))

    rows <- lapply(rs, function(k) {
      g          <- gl_normed[[k]]
      supervised <- !is.null(g) && !is.null(g$type) &&
        identical(g$type, "covariate_dependent")
      if (supervised) {
        vals <- g$gamma
        length(vals) <- q_max
        note <- ""
      } else {
        vals <- rep(NA_real_, q_max)
        note <- "no covariates for this component"
      }
      c(list(Rank = paste0("R", k), Note = note),
        stats::setNames(as.list(vals), col_names))
    })

    do.call(rbind.data.frame, c(rows, list(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)))
  }, na = "", digits = 3, striped = TRUE, bordered = TRUE)
}
```
